title.en: Read an SF Survival player attribute

summary.en: Choose the player field for one of SF Survival's six attribute-based settings.
summary.de: Wähle das Spielerfeld für eine der sechs attributbasierten SF-Survival-Einstellungen.

codeTemplate:
local players, queryReason = runtime.ecs.query("keen::ecs::PlayerInput")
if not players then return nil, queryReason end
local entity = players[1]
if not entity then return nil, "No player entity" end
local session = runtime.world.session_id()
local context = { active = true, session = session, entity = entity }
local target, reason = runtime.overrides.attribute(entity, {{field}}, context)
if not target then return nil, reason end
return target.read()

title.en: Read SF Survival's fall damage template

summary.en: Follow the same template read SF Survival uses for noFallDamage.
summary.de: Führe denselben Template-Leseweg aus, den SF Survival für noFallDamage verwendet.

codeTemplate:
local players, queryReason = runtime.ecs.query("keen::ecs::PlayerInput")
if not players then return nil, queryReason end
local entity = players[1]
if not entity then return nil, "No player entity" end
local view, reason = runtime.ecs.get_template_component(entity, "keen::ecs::FallDamage")
if not view then return nil, reason end
local target, targetReason = runtime.overrides.template(view, "fallDamageStartDistance", {"fallDamageLethalDistance"})
if not target then return nil, targetReason end
return target.read()

responseNote.en: The first call returned a shared FallDamage view and nil reason. The target read captured both start and lethal distances.
